metadata.title: फ़क़ीरा भाई की खट्टी भिंडी के साथ अरहर की दाल | The Tribal Kitchen | Main Bhi Bharat
metadata.description:
In this episode of The Tribal Kitchen, we take you to the Valsad district of Gujarat, which is the land of the Bhil tribals. We cook Khatti Bhindi with Fakirabhai from a small village of Valsad.

For updates regarding upcoming videos and stories follows our social media accounts linked below:: 

Facebook:: https://www.facebook.com/mainbhibharat/

Instagram:: https://www.instagram.com/mainbhibharat/

Twitter:: https://twitter.com/mbb_plus

Website:: http://www.mainbhibharat.co.in
